description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between loss and TFLOPs for two models—Vanilla and SepLLM—across a range of computational resources. The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPs," is scaled linearly from 0.00 to 1.25, with values marked at intervals of 0.25, and is presented in units of 10⁹. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," is also linear, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The Vanilla model, represented by a purple line with triangle markers, starts at a loss of approximately 2.75 at 0.00 TFLOPs and exhibits a steep initial decline, gradually leveling off to a loss of about 2.51 at 1.25 TFLOPs. In contrast, the SepLLM model, shown with a red line and circular markers, begins at a loss of approximately 2.72 at 0.00 TFLOPs and follows a similar downward trend, reaching a loss of about 2.48 at 1.25 TFLOPs. A horizontal green dashed line at a loss of 2.50 spans the plot, and a vertical green dashed box highlights the region between 1.00 and 1.25 TFLOPs, where the SepLLM model achieves a loss below the 2.50 threshold. The text "1.28×" is annotated within this box, indicating a 1.28-fold improvement in efficiency or performance at this point.
